bio.text: Kelly Grappe is the Democratic nominee for Arkansas Secretary of State in 2026.
Grappe graduated from Sylvan Hills High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Lyon College in 1993.

According to the campaign website, Grappe worked for nearly 25 years in operations leadership at Alltel and Verizon, currently works in learning and development at a multi-state dental organization based in Little Rock, and previously owned a small business and operated a farm in Rose Bud, Arkansas.
